controls: Watch AI in the main menu. P pauses/resumes; Exit demo returns to the main menu. Wishes continue automatically.
method: A dedicated worker searches legal held/released jump and dash combinations with a stratified beam of 48 states over 120 native physics steps. It forecasts only the two currently generated terrain blocks and replans ahead of committed inputs.
rules: Uses the unmodified Game.step physics and collision/scoring methods. Forecasts suppress cosmetic effects and extrapolate known terrain, without sampling the live generator or inventing favorable future platforms.
routes: Starts from reproducible procedural seed 4. After each three-wish demo game, the seed increments. Human games restore their normal Math.random source.
score_isolation: Demo best wishes are session-only. AI scores never update the human personal best or open the global score submission form.
performance: Planning stays in a worker. The render thread applies a buffered input per physics step and forecasts a short commitment prefix. Human play creates no AI worker. Exit terminates the worker.
review_fixes: Opening terrain density accounts for the close-up on high-density phones, with the existing resolution and memory caps.
All deer poses are uploaded during artwork warmup.
Demo touch controls and tutorial hints are suppressed; menu controls remain separate from scores and settings.
Worker startup failure returns to a playable human menu. Stale results are discarded by session and physics tick.
The original eight-frame brown Uniboar sprite and animation are restored in gameplay, the menus and wish icons.
regression_reference: tests/demo-reference.json replays 4,532 legal AI control steps to 120,002 points in one wish with the raised 60-pixel speed cap, using the ordinary engine and generator.

live_browser.environment: Chrome on Windows, RTX 3070, 1280x800 viewport at DPR 2
